prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'home, redesign', as each has only 1 test.
For 'adoption, redesign', noise-corrected results consistently show ~+2.5% gain across 2 tests; it proved helpful when significant (Round 6), though Round 4 showed no clear effect.
Predictions for 'adoption, redesign' were accurate compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too high for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'home, redesign' compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Persistence Warning Flow: Add an explicit persistence notice and backup callout during sign-in to explain why account creation preserves pet data. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming and confirmation step right after adoption photo upload. (why: Adoption drop-off is 70.2% and 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation result issues.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Rendering Progress Time Estimate: Display explicit progress stages and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while background assets render. (why: The waiting screen ('home' step) has a long mean duration of 2336s, leading to user abandonment before desktop launch.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Late Sign In Flow Reorder: Reorder onboarding so users pick or create their pet before being asked to sign in. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and early authentication before choosing a pet creates friction.)
4: [adoption, copy] Photo Requirements Guidance Copy: Clarify image requirements on the photo upload screen with clear text guidelines regarding lighting and background contrast. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
5: [home, hint] Background Waiting Activity Hints: Display rotating tip carousels during the waiting screen to inform users what the desktop pet can do once ready. (why: The waiting step has high median/mean duration (201s / 2336s), causing drop-off while pet setup finishes.)
6: [finish, incentive] First Interaction Welcome Badge: Add an achievement badge visual element on the launch screen encouraging users to complete the final setup step. (why: Overall onboarding completion drops from 81.3% home to 64.8% finish step.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Single Tap Authentication Layout: Switch the sign_in screen to a centered layout with prominent quick auth choices and backup sign in options. (why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalls or missing sign in screens, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.)

scores.note: High support ticket volume (8 emails) supports sign-in persistence fixes, though new flows carry release overhead.
Target step drop is high, but historical new_screen tests showed negative lift (-0.8%).
Addresses high waiting duration (2336s mean) on home step with progress indicators.
Reduces early friction by delaying 27.1% sign-in drop step until after pet selection.
Low cost config-only copy tweak directly backed by 3 support tickets and 29.8% adoption drop.
Engages users during 201s median render wait, though target step drop is lower than finish/adoption.
Finish step has highest drop (35.2%), but previous finish step changes showed negative lift (-1.1%).
Addresses 27.1% sign-in drop and 2 support tickets regarding sign-in stalls.
